limit.description: Maximum simultaneous requests per binding; excess receives 503 without queuing.

request_remove.description: Allowed outgoing request headers to remove.

burst.description: Maximum immediately available tokens; excess receives 429 without queuing.

requests_per_second.description: Token refill rate per binding in requests per second.

token_envs.description: Unique environment references containing Bearer tokens of at least 32 bytes; values are never stored in configuration. Required in manage and serve, including disabled definitions.
